summary: Projected the rewritten ESSENCE (pillar 1, most-abstract model) into canonical state and completed the first implementation batch. Spec: S-001..S-018 (must, from 必須対応事項/成功条件/前提事項) and S-019..S-022 (should, from 任意対応事項). Todo: T-001..T-013 (must) following the 遂行順序 phases, T-014..T-017 (should). Executed T-001+T-002: created src/domain (pure domain layer — types.ts, blockTree.ts, view.ts, validatorSet.ts, index.ts) with reference types View/Vote/Block, anchor block at slot 0 (sentinel parent/proposer -1), immutable BlockTree with ancestry/leaf queries, validator count 4..10 default 4, plus tests incl. a mechanical import-purity test. Evidence: npm run typecheck exit 0, npm test exit 0 (13 files / 100 tests), npm run build exit 0. Decisions: (1) keep Vite+React+TS stack (Essence delegates stack choice); (2) leave M1 code in place until phase2 UI replacement so the build gate stays green — the discard premise is honored by replacement, not by an up-front delete; (3) anchor-at-slot-0 / first-proposal-at-slot-1 interpretation recorded in the handoff for human visibility. No Essence ambiguity blocking progress; no high-risk paths touched.

Executed batch T-003+T-004 (phase1-core, cost 8). T-003: protocol skeleton in src/domain — forkChoice.ts (LMD latest-vote selection with order-independent same-slot equivocation tie-break, GHOST subtree weights, deterministic smallest-index tie-break), finality.ts (SLOTS_PER_EPOCH=4 minimal epoch notion, checkpointFor with empty-boundary-slot fallback, supermajority=ceil(2n/3), justification fixpoint from the anchor, adjacent-epoch 1-finality), protocol.ts (round-robin proposer schedule, buildProposal on the GHOST head, buildAttestation with source=justified checkpoint / target=current-epoch checkpoint). T-004: simulation.ts — SimulationConfig{validatorCount, seed}, advanceSlot (propose, all validators attest, recompute finality and heads), stateAtSlot as pure recomputation from the anchor, which IS the rewind path. Evidence: npm run typecheck exit 0, npm test exit 0 (16 files / 128 tests — finality timeline verified: justifiedHead 0→4 at slot 4, finalized 4 at slot 8, 8 at slot 12), npm run build exit 0. Decisions (discretion, no reference-type semantics change): SLOTS_PER_EPOCH=4; checkpoint epoch derived from block slot; equivocation resolved lexicographically for determinism; delivery still instant/shared-view — T-005 introduces per-validator visibility on top of this driver. No blockers; no high-risk paths.

Executed batch T-005 (last of phase1-core). Introduced the message-visibility model: messages.ts (append-only MessageLog, every block/vote carries publishedAt), localView.ts (Delivery rule type with instantDelivery as the identity default; viewOf computes a validator's View as a pure filter over the log, holding back blocks whose parent is invisible together with their descendants; observe bundles view+finality+head per validator), and reworked simulation.ts so the proposer builds from its own view (slots < s), all attesters of a slot vote simultaneously (blocks ≤ s, votes ≤ s-1 — replaces the earlier sequential intra-slot attestation, making votes order-independent), and per-validator heads come from local views while tree/votes/finality remain the god view. Evidence: typecheck 0, test 0 (17 files / 138 tests — includes partition divergence within/across camps, post-heal convergence by slot 10, orphan exclusion, determinism under a custom delivery; the pre-existing finality-timeline and rewind tests pass unchanged), build 0. Decision: intra-slot attestation semantics changed from sequential to simultaneous — recorded as discretionary (no persisted scenarios exist; reference-type semantics untouched). completed_todos_since_reset reached the threshold (5): handoff written for a context reset; next session starts phase2-ui at T-006 from disk alone.

Cycle 4 executed phase2-ui batch T-006+T-007 (both done with evidence). Removed all M1 code (src/core, src/protocol, src/setup.ts, old src/ui views/controls, 10 M1 test files, verify-visual.mjs) and built the replacement UI on src/domain only: App shell with chain/network/global mode tabs, slot bar (+1 advance, next-proposer display), validator count 4-10 selector (restarts scenario), theme toggle; chain mode with local (observe-based) / god perspective toggle, SVG block tree (slot columns, deterministic DFS row layout, J/F badges, head chips, vote-support chips), status panel and LMD latest-vote table; network/global modes are placeholders until T-008. README.md rewritten for the new design. Verification: typecheck 0, vitest 9 files / 67 tests 0 (incl. new jsdom DOM tests for the shell and chain mode, and treeLayout unit tests), vite build 0. Two environment dead ends recovered: sandbox denies port listen (EPERM) and cdn.playwright.dev, so the prepared real-browser smoke (scripts/verify-ui.mjs, file://-based) is deferred to a human-enabled run — recorded as Non-blocking Recommendation R-001 — and jsdom covers the same interactions headlessly (lesson L-20260827T233715+0900-c77c). Decisions within discretion: SVG rendering for the block tree (tech-stack discretion), salvaged M1's validated colour palette / theme system, jsdom as the autonomous UI-verification layer. No Essence reinterpretation; UI info-design choices stay within the first-build scope the Essence grants.
